args.summary: Overnight re-review of the queued target. The LIVE overnight US tape has STABILIZED, not sold off — US futures mildly green (ES +0.10%, NQ +0.19%, YM +0.41%), VIX -3.64%. Asia is weak (KOSPI -1.78%, Hang Seng -2.04%, Shanghai -0.81%) and Europe firm (Euro Stoxx +1.40%, DAX +1.35%); WTI -3.38% and 10Y +0.57% to 5.15%. Because US risk has stabilized I do NOT de-risk the equity sleeve further; because breadth is weak (b200 pctile 16%), dealers are short gamma (net GEX -6.8bn) and the in-house read is 'ELEVATED drawdown risk (74/100) — de-risk' under a LOW-confidence (0.112), TRANSITIONING label with degraded inputs, I also do NOT aggressively redeploy cash with no confirmed new entry. Net change vs the queued book: finish exiting MU (planless, thesis-less, -14.6%, Prophet held_without_active_plan) into overnight Asia-semi weakness; hold XOM, MSFT, AAPL. Book stays defensive: ~27% gross, ~73% cash, concentrated in confirmed energy leadership (XOM) and a quality anchor (MSFT).

holdings.rationale: The single fully-confirmed leadership position in the book: decision matrix 8-bull/0-bear, confirmed uptrend above 50/200d with MACD positive, Energy (XLE) is sector RS rank #1 (20d momentum +8.5%), and the energy_complex theme is top-3/49. Rising-inflation regime (inflation score +0.56) is a direct tailwind. This name satisfies Charter P1 across price, sector, theme and macro planes — not the label alone.
holdings.why_now: Overnight WTI -3.38% is a one-night headwind, not a thesis break: XOM is +12% within a confirmed uptrend and XLE still holds RS leadership. No plane has flipped, so I hold rather than trim into a single-session oil dip.
holdings.falsifier: XLE loses RS-#1 leadership OR XOM closes below its rising 50d / the ~131 Prophet invalidation, OR energy_complex theme rolls out of the top decile. A sustained (multi-session) crude breakdown below ~90 would also force a re-size.
evidence: XLE sector RS rank #1, 20d momentum +8.54% (market_packet sector_rs_top)
Prophet management: XOM hold, triggered_pre_t1, invalidation 131.13 vs price ~178
holdings.expected_horizon: medium (quarters) while energy leadership and inflation tailwind persist
holdings.exit_plan: Trim/exit on falsifier: XLE loss of RS leadership, 50d break, or sustained crude breakdown below ~90. Otherwise ride the confirmed uptrend toward Prophet t1 ~213.

holdings.rationale: Quality mega-cap core anchor. Prophet management plan is hold (triggered_pre_t1) with price ~533 far above the 341.6 invalidation. Durable FCF and low fundamental fragility make it the appropriate equity anchor in an elevated-drawdown, weak-breadth tape. Modest 10% position, +4%, no thesis break.
holdings.why_now: US overnight tape stabilized (futures green, VIX -3.6%) and MSFT carries no negative signal; no reason to touch a healthy anchor. XLK 20d momentum is soft (-4%) but MSFT sits far above invalidation and is a defensive-quality, not a high-beta semi, exposure.
holdings.falsifier: Close below the ~341.6 Prophet invalidation, a durable break of the 200d, or a fundamental FCF/guidance deterioration.
evidence: Prophet management: MSFT hold, triggered_pre_t1, invalidation 341.6 vs price ~533
holdings.exit_plan: Hold while above 200d and Prophet invalidation; trim only on a fundamental thesis change or to fund a higher-confirmation entry.

holdings.rationale: Trivial residual quality toehold (0.74% weight, +13%) left from a prior disciplined trim. Prophet shows held_without_active_plan but it carries no negative signal; too small to matter to risk and not worth paying spread/slippage to close.
holdings.why_now: Immaterial to overnight risk at 0.74% weight; no signal change tonight. Not worth transaction cost to close on an overnight re-review.
holdings.falsifier: A material negative Prophet/technical signal, or the position being swept into a broader defensive de-risk if the tape turns.
holdings.exit_plan: Fold into the next rebalance or exit alongside a broader de-risk; no standalone catalyst needed.

exit_decisions.reason: MU carries no stated thesis (rationale null) and Prophet flags it held_without_active_plan; it is -14.6% and was already 65%-trimmed on 2026-10-09. It is the only confirmation-free, underwater name in the book and now faces a direct overnight headwind.
evidence: rationale is null in get_my_book; Prophet held_without_active_plan
overnight Asia-semiconductor weakness: KOSPI -1.78%, Hang Seng -2.04%, SMH 20d momentum -8.07%
exit_decisions.falsifier: A fresh confirmed memory/semiconductor upcycle signal (SMH regaining RS leadership, Prophet re-opening an active MU plan) would reverse the exit.
exit_decisions.why_now: The overnight Asia-semi selloff is the catalyst to finish what the prior trim started — closing a planless, thesis-less, losing position rather than carrying it into a weak-breadth open.

falsifiers: US tape turns from stabilized to a genuine selloff before the open (futures roll red, VIX spikes) — would force a deeper de-risk, not a lean-in.
XOM thesis breaks: XLE loses RS leadership, XOM breaks 50d, or crude breaks down durably below ~90 on the back of tonight's -3.4%.
A confirmed, triggered new entry appears (Prophet discovery name moves from pre_trigger to triggered with gate_go), which would justify deploying part of the 73% cash.
evidence_planes: in-house regime / macro_context (Q2 Reflation, confidence 0.112, TRANSITIONING)
sector rotation / sector_central (ELEVATED drawdown risk 74/100, breadth b200 pctile 16%, net GEX -6.8bn)
args.expected_failure_mode: The most likely way this book loses money: the green US futures are a fakeout into weak breadth and short-gamma fragility, the tape reverses after the open, and I am caught holding a concentrated energy bet (XOM 16%) just as crude's overnight -3.4% extends into a real rollover — so a single-name energy drawdown drives most of the loss while 73% cash earns little. Secondary risk: by staying defensive I under-earn if the stabilization is real and leadership broadens without me.
args.cash_rationale: Holding ~73% cash on this overnight re-review is a deliberate degraded-data + elevated-drawdown decision, not passive drift. Justification required by the cash_opportunity_cost lesson: (1) Degraded data — regime label confidence 0.112 (LOW) and TRANSITIONING with 3 contradicting legs; inflation-axis confidence collapsed 56%→18%; treasury_auctions collector dead (circuit breaker open); neural_web stale. (2) Elevated risk — in-house read is 'ELEVATED drawdown risk (74/100) — de-risk', index near 1y high on weak breadth (b200 pctile 16%), dealers short gamma (net GEX -6.8bn). (3) Candidates rejected after search — all Prophet discovery names (HII, SGI, CAVA, ENSG) are pre_trigger/wait, none triggered; INTU/NOC are non-held candidate holds, not triggered entries; no name clears a confirmed gate tonight. With no confirmed entry and a fragile tape, cash is the correct risk posture; I will redeploy on a triggered, gated confirmation.
args.liquidity_notes: All names are large/mega-cap with ample liquidity; MU exit (~$30k, 3% weight) and no new adds mean negligible market impact at the open.
args.sold_note: Exiting MU in full — planless, thesis-less (rationale null, Prophet held_without_active_plan), -14.6%, already 65%-trimmed 2026-10-09 — into overnight Asia-semiconductor weakness. No other sells; XOM/MSFT/AAPL held.

decision_memo.market_frame: Overnight US tape stabilized (ES +0.10%, NQ +0.19%, YM +0.41%, VIX -3.64%) — not a selloff — but Asia weak (KOSPI -1.78%, HSI -2.04%), crude -3.38%, 10Y +0.57% to 5.15%. In-house planes flag fragility: LOW-confidence (0.112) TRANSITIONING Reflation label, ELEVATED drawdown risk 74/100, weak breadth, short dealer gamma. Posture: hold defensive, neither de-risk further nor aggressively lean in.
decision_memo.changes: vs queued book: full exit of MU; XOM/MSFT/AAPL held unchanged; cash rises ~70%->~73%.
decision_memo.timing: Overnight re-review; all actions settle at the OPEN, not now. Single clean change (MU exit) to avoid churn into a fragile, short-gamma open.
rejected: HII/SGI/CAVA/ENSG — Prophet discovery but all pre_trigger/wait, none gated tonight
INTU/NOC — candidate holds, not held and not triggered entries
Broad cash redeployment — rejected: no confirmed/gated entry into weak-breadth, short-gamma tape
alternatives: De-risk further (trim XOM on oil -3.4%) — rejected: one-night oil move is not a thesis break and US tape stabilized
Lean back in / deploy cash — rejected: green futures into weak breadth + short gamma is hidden fragility; degraded data and no triggered entry
decision_memo.risk_deliberation: Elevated drawdown risk and degraded inputs argue for defense; stabilized US futures argue against further selling. Resolution: hold the confirmed leaders, cut the one unconfirmed loser (MU), keep cash as dry powder for a gated entry. Concentration risk in XOM accepted because it is the one multi-plane-confirmed name (Charter P1).
